interpretation: Technique identifiers and PDF page occurrences are taken from the FBI table, with the printed T11558.003 normalized to MITRE T1558.003. Display labels may expand or normalize the table's wording. Synthetic abstractions exercise authorization and effect invariants. NOT_MODELED_V0.1 entries are explicit containment decisions.

techniques.name: Active Scanning
techniques.rationale: External scanning is outside the bounded local authorization laboratory.

techniques.name: Cloud Infrastructure Discovery
techniques.rationale: Models authorization on synthetic infrastructure metadata without cloud access.

techniques.name: Account Discovery: Cloud Account
techniques.rationale: Models synthetic principal identity boundaries without account enumeration.

techniques.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Cloud Groups
techniques.rationale: Models permission-scope boundaries without querying a cloud tenant.

techniques.name: Cloud Service Discovery
techniques.rationale: Models protected synthetic service metadata only.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.rationale: Tests server-side authorization failure conditions; no exploit is reproduced.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.rationale: Exercises current authority, identity binding, lifecycle, and replay with synthetic credentials.

techniques.name: External Remote Services
techniques.rationale: The harness exposes no remote service and contacts no network target.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.rationale: Tests a local supplier-origin trust binding without a supplier system.

techniques.name: Trusted Relationship
techniques.rationale: Tests synthetic trusted-origin substitution.

techniques.name: Forge Web Credentials: SAML Tokens
techniques.rationale: Models verified-versus-authorized credential claims; creates no SAML token.

techniques.name: Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files
techniques.rationale: Uses an inert synthetic presented credential, not credential acquisition.

techniques.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
techniques.rationale: Payload deployment and command shells are prohibited.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
techniques.rationale: Models synthetic cloud-style credential lifecycle only.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials
techniques.rationale: Tests unregistered credential and revocation/recovery handling.

techniques.name: Hijack Execution Flow: DLL
techniques.rationale: Native execution-flow hijacking is outside the authorization model.

techniques.name: Masquerading
techniques.rationale: Models principal-label substitution only; no file or process masquerading.

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.rationale: The harness transfers no tools or payloads.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.rationale: No arbitrary command or script execution interface exists.

techniques.name: Access Token Manipulation: Token Impersonation/Theft
techniques.rationale: Models inert access-token claim substitution.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Roles
techniques.rationale: Attempts a protected synthetic role assignment outside granted scope.

techniques.name: Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API
techniques.rationale: Models authorization on inert synthetic metadata; no metadata endpoint exists.

techniques.name: Forge Web Credentials
techniques.rationale: Exercises credential-claim binding without forging credentials.

techniques.name: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting
techniques.rationale: Models alternate authorization material and replay only; no Kerberos operation. The FBI table prints the invalid ID T11558.003; this inventory uses MITRE's T1558.003.

techniques.name: Software Discovery: Security Software Discovery
techniques.rationale: Endpoint and sensor discovery is outside the local authorization fixture.

techniques.name: Credentials from Password Stores
techniques.rationale: Models denial of a protected synthetic secret-store read; reads no credentials.

techniques.name: Account Discovery: Domain Account
techniques.rationale: Models principal authorization without domain enumeration.

techniques.name: Unsecured Credentials: Group Policy Preferences
techniques.rationale: Models a denied synthetic protected read, not Group Policy access.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
techniques.rationale: No PowerShell or command execution is permitted.

techniques.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Ticket
techniques.rationale: Tests inert alternate-credential substitution and replay.

techniques.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Hash
techniques.rationale: Tests inert alternate-credential substitution and replay.

techniques.name: Remote Services: Windows Remote Management
techniques.rationale: The harness exposes and contacts no remote management service.

techniques.name: Adversary-in-the-Middle: LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning and SMB Relay
techniques.rationale: Network interception and relay behavior are prohibited.

techniques.name: Email Collection: Remote Email Collection
techniques.rationale: Models authorization on inert synthetic records and transfers; no mailbox exists.

techniques.name: Cloud Secrets Management Stores
techniques.rationale: Models a protected synthetic secret resource without cloud access.

techniques.name: Data from Cloud Storage
techniques.rationale: Transfers only inert locally generated data between in-memory synthetic namespaces.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.rationale: Uses synthetic fixture data only; reads no host data.

techniques.name: Data Staged: Local Data Staging
techniques.rationale: Models an in-memory synthetic transfer authorization boundary, not staging.

techniques.name: Data Staged: Remote Data Staging
techniques.rationale: The destination is an in-memory synthetic-sink URI, never remote.

techniques.name: Proxy
techniques.rationale: The harness creates no network connections or proxy traffic.

techniques.name: Proxy: Multi-hop Proxy
techniques.rationale: The harness creates no network connections or proxy chains.

techniques.name: Protocol Tunneling
techniques.rationale: Protocol tunneling is outside the contained authorization model.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.rationale: No HTTP or other application-layer network traffic is generated.
